sources.name: ArchDaily
sources.summary: Snøhetta 's Shanghai Grand Opera House has entered its final construction phase. Preparations are underway for the building's official opening on October 17, 2026, kicking off a performance season featuring 82 performances across 47 acclaimed productions. Snøhetta's spiralling design for the new cultural venue was selected via an international competition in 2016. In 2019, the architecture firm, along with East China Architectural Design & Research Institute (ECADI), Theatre Projects , and Nagata Acoustics , was formally commissioned to deliver the building from concept to completion. The project was originally set to be completed in 2025 , as part of a broader cultural master plan aimed at reinforcing Shanghai's role as an international centre of culture and innovation.
